description: This Java source file defines a REST controller class 'ShelfController' for managing book shelves in a book tracking application. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, renaming, and deleting shelves, and interacts with services for predefined and user-created shelves.

classes.name: ShelfController
classes.description: REST controller for managing shelves, providing endpoints for listing, creating, renaming, and deleting shelves.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all shelves (predefined and user-created) for the logged-in user.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new custom shelf with the specified name.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to rename an existing user-created shelf.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a user-created shelf by name.
